description: Rules from spec/02-scheme.md: the scheme reference is a name plus an opaque label.

vectors.name: scheme/member-required
vectors.description: Every record states which scheme its project uses, even if the answer is 'none'.

vectors.name: scheme/name-lowercase
vectors.description: Scheme names are lowercase tokens; 'SemVer' is not a scheme name.

vectors.name: scheme/project-name-accepted
vectors.description: A project-specific name is opaque to the consumer and valid without a prefix; the prefix is only a SHOULD (SCH-10).

vectors.name: scheme/namespaced-name-accepted
vectors.description: The x- prefix keeps a project-specific scheme out of the reserved namespace.

vectors.name: scheme/none-carries-no-version
vectors.description: 'none' means the project assigns no label; carrying one contradicts it.

vectors.name: scheme/version-required
vectors.description: Every scheme except 'none' needs a label.

vectors.name: scheme/none-accepted
vectors.description: A file that never had a version is described honestly with 'none'.

vectors.name: scheme/authority-absolute-uri
vectors.description: An authority identifies the definition of the scheme, so it needs a scheme part.

vectors.name: scheme/authority-accepted
vectors.description: An absolute URI is accepted and not resolved.

vectors.name: scheme/version-is-opaque
vectors.description: The label is not trimmed, case-folded or parsed; spaces survive validation untouched.

vectors.name: scheme/sequence-non-negative
vectors.description: A sequence is a counter, never negative.

vectors.name: scheme/sequence-accepted
vectors.description: Zero is a legitimate first value of a sequence.
